attribution: Derived visualization of NOAA/NWS NEXRAD Level II data, accessed via NSF Unidata's public archive.

processing.sampling: Nearest native polar gate, no temporal or spatial interpolation; spherical azimuthal-equidistant ground range with standard 4/3-Earth beam model; EPSG:3857 raster pixel centers.
processing.missing: Below-threshold, missing and range-folded Level II gates remain transparent.
processing.time: Each product's time is its sweep midpoint, with full scan start/end and visible-region ray-time range preserved in products. Frame time follows reflectivity.
processing.velocity: Uncorrected base radial velocity relative to KTLX. Negative values move toward the radar; positive away. Not storm-relative velocity or tornado wind speed. Aliasing is possible beyond each sweep's Nyquist velocity.
processing.resolution: Native range-gate spacing and measured azimuth spacing are recorded per product. Raster sampling is about 151 m; native azimuth footprint increases with distance and is coarser than the raster near El Reno.
processing.geometry: Radar measurements are elevated above ground. This overlay must not be interpreted as a surveyed tornado boundary.
